title: 统一值不值——一套压缩方法、一个图上的硬核定理、三次自我检视，与一堵没绕开的墙 / Is Unification Worth It? A Compression Method, a Graph-Theoretic Theorem, Three Self-Checks, and a Wall Left Standing
description:
本书处理一个反复被提出、却极少被严格表述的问题：现代数学能否从一个更原始的概念出发被重新组织，从而减少彼此重复的层次？答案是把区分（distinction）当作基本对象，把演化当作区分结构的变化，由此构造演化区分系统（Evolutionary Distinction System, EDS）。全书的贡献不是宣布一个大一统理论，而是把主张拆成可分级、可批判、可证伪的命题：唯一完全严格的部分是有限图上的相变定理——区分耦合越过两个由拉普拉斯谱决定的临界值时，系统经历“局部先于全局”的两阶段相变，证明只用实对称矩阵的谱定理与线性常微分方程。在这个硬核之上，本书把生成拓扑、非标准分析、同伦类型论、微分形式、测度论、调和分析、概率论、信息论、微分几何等十余个领域重新安放为同一套语言的特例，并逐处标注每一对应是严格的、启发式的还是可疑的。全书以一个具体的不一致收束：把热核展开给出的分离曲率 κ=R/6 与 Gauss–Bonnet 定理对照，会出现一个因子 1/3 的缺口；本书不假装填上它，而是把它转化为一个可攻击的研究纲领，并追踪它与轨形、模曲线 X(3)、椭圆上同调中反复出现的 1/3 之间的可能联系。附录 E 为每一个可反驳命题登记了证伪条件与核验日期。

源码、构建流程、可复现数值脚本与可证伪登记簿见 GitHub。内容许可 CC BY 4.0；代码许可 MIT。

English. This monograph asks whether modern mathematics can be reorganized from a more primitive notion so as to reduce duplicated layers. It takes distinction as the basic object and evolution as the change of distinction structure, yielding the Evolutionary Distinction System (EDS). Its contribution is not a grand unified theory but a set of gradeable, criticizable, falsifiable propositions. The only fully rigorous part is a phase-transition theorem on finite graphs: as the distinction coupling crosses two spectral thresholds, the system undergoes a two-stage transition in which local distinctions unlock before global ones; the proof uses only the spectral theorem for real symmetric matrices and linear ODEs. On this hard core, the book re-encodes some fifteen fields — generative topology, nonstandard analysis, homotopy type theory, differential forms, measure theory, harmonic analysis, probability, information theory, differential geometry — into one language, marking each correspondence as rigorous, heuristic, or suspect. It closes on a concrete inconsistency: comparing the heat-kernel separation curvature κ=R/6 with Gauss–Bonnet leaves a factor-of-1/3 gap, which the book does not pretend to close but converts into an attackable research program, tracking the recurring 1/3 in orbifolds, the modular curve X(3), and elliptic cohomology. Appendix E registers a falsification condition and a check date for every refutable proposition.
